Slay the [[Tempest Drake]]s in [[Diviner's Ascent]] and learn what it takes to change your secondary [[profession]] to [[Mesmer]].
{{TOCright}}

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
* Not being [[Profession|primary or secondary]] [[Mesmer]].
* Did not complete [[Augury Rock]] for the first time as a secondary Mesmer.

===Objectives===
* Go through [[Skyward Reach]] to [[Diviner's Ascent]].
* Slay all three [[Tempest Drake|tempest drakes]] in a single battle.
* [0...3]/3 tempest drakes slain.
* Return to [[Eulenias]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 200 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* Mesmer available for secondary profession

==Walkthrough==
This is easiest to accomplish leaving [[Elona Reach (outpost)|Elona Reach]]. Hug the south wall, moving to the [[teleporter]]s, and continue eastward, hugging the north wall to where it makes a sharp northward turn, then straight out to the end of the area. The Tempest Drakes are immediately north of this position, and will not separate from their [[mob]]. [[Area of effect]] skills and some hit and run tactics will easily defeat all three very quickly. After the going through teleporter, if you do not hug the north wall, there is a good chance that you will [[aggro]] the [[Sand Wurm]] which dwells in the middle of this explorable area.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Eulenias
:''"Those who are not Mesmers think our abilities lack substance. In a way they are right, because those who follow the inspiration of [[Lyssa]] know that the mind is far more powerful than the mere matter.''

:''Perhaps you would care to join us? If so you must learn to steady your mind. As a first test, travel through [[Skyward Reach]] to '''Diviner's Ascent''' and slay three of the legendary '''tempest drakes'''. Maintaining your focus in this battle will show whether or not you have the temperament to be a Mesmer."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I do not doubt my abilities.
| decline = I'm not interested.
| ask = If you cannot even remember the task I gave you, it seems dubious that you have the mental acumen to be a Mesmer. For the last time, travel through Skyward Reach to '''Diviner's Ascent''' and slay three of the legendary '''tempest drakes'''.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Eulenias
:''"You've slain the tempest drakes? Well done. I must admit that I had my doubts about you, but it seems you may indeed have something of what is required to be a Mesmer."''
